title: Issuer payment emitted as a three-topic mint event carrying the text memo as to_muxed_id
why: A payment whose operation source is the asset issuer is emitted as a mint event [mint, to, asset] with three topics, and the transaction's text memo is copied into its to_muxed_id. Readers that look for to_muxed_id only on transfer events, or that turn the memo text into a muxed ID, get the routing wrong.

variants.notes: Real pubnet ledger with 382 transactions; this entry's pattern is transaction 75 in apply order (position 185 in the transaction set). Written by stellar-core 28.0.1 at Protocol 28; the object's LastModified is five days after the ledger closed, but the writer is of the same protocol era, so it is not marked regenerated.

values.note: The operation source is the issuer of the asset paid, so the SAC event is a mint, not a transfer.
The CAP-67 mint layout: three topics, no admin topic.

known_divergences.detail: Executed at v2.8.34 (2b24ec89) through the replay harness: export_token_transfer writes the mint of transaction 6591994c… with to_muxed MBN32NH6…ATXO (the recipient's key with muxed ID 0) and to_muxed_id "0", where the event carries the text "psp:160886906"; the harness reports routing u64:0 against text. Every other compared fact matched (382 transactions, receipts, participants). Upstream keeps this behaviour on purpose and pins it in a test.

Executed again at 7e3fc9af (v2.8.35, pinned, 2026-11-18) with the same result as at 2b24ec89. Executed at v2.8.34 (2b24ec89) through the replay harness: export_token_transfer writes the mint of transaction 6591994c… with to_muxed MBN32NH6…ATXO (the recipient's key with muxed ID 0) and to_muxed_id "0", where the event carries the text "psp:160886906"; the harness reports routing u64:0 against text. Every other compared fact matched (382 transactions, receipts, participants). Upstream keeps this behaviour on purpose and pins it in a test.

notes: The issuer signs as operation source but none of its ledger entries change (issuing creates no issuer balance), so it is not under participants.must_include. Must-not facts: the mint has routing type text, so a reader that reports a u64 muxed ID is wrong (rule M-2), and a reader that records this as a transfer from the issuer has the wrong movement kind. stellar-etl#450 has been executed against this ledger at v2.8.34 and is declared as a known divergence (evidence/stellar-etl/). Member of the family cap-0067/to-muxed-id-text-from-memo.
